headline: Easy aerobic run today: recovery has rebounded after yesterday's rest
summary: Garmin recorded 6h 42m sleep (score 81), sleeping heart rate 65 bpm, resting heart rate 58 bpm, Body Battery 82 on waking, and Training Readiness 80. Yesterday contained no recorded workout and matched the prior rest prescription. The low acute load and strong recharge support one controlled easy run today, without a speed session.

recommendation.title: One easy aerobic run
details: Run 35–45 minutes easy and conversational, on a familiar flat-to-gently rolling route. Keep the effort deliberately controlled; no pace target.
Do not add intervals, hills, tempo running, or strides today. Finish with 5–10 minutes of easy walking if useful.
City-level Sydney forecast context: roughly 15–22°C from morning through afternoon; choose comfortable clothing and hydrate normally.
recommendation.alternative: If you feel flat during the warm-up, change to 20–30 minutes of easy walking or take complete rest.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.
